rationale: Exhaustive enumeration over step-feasible dispatch commands (ev_a in {-4,0,4,8} kW, ev_b in {-3,0,3,6} kW per 0.5 h interval) respecting power limits, capacity, discharge efficiency and reserve SOC maximizes critical-load service at 12.0 kWh. Scheduled ev_a at 4 kW for all intervals and ev_b at 6 kW for t1,t2, which serves the full load at t1 (5 kWh) and as much as possible at t2 (5 kWh) and t3 (2 kWh). Final SOCs sit at 17.333/13.333 kWh, above the 16/12 kWh reserves, and this final SOC is identical across all co-optimal schedules.
